name: Yasukata Eito
source:
Element: Oxygen
Rank: 純参位
Hobby/Skill: Sunbathing/Super Sentai Heroes

The bright and energetic mood maker. A good guy who is honest and treats everyone evenly. He believes since he is alive, he should enjoy his life to the fullest. Will do anything to bring smiles to those he cares about.
